llamapalooza.configuration.alwaysSpit.to: If true, Loot Llamas will always spit items even when there are no players nearby. Otherwise, they will only spit items when a player is within 16 blocks of them. [default = false]
llamapalooza.configuration.speedReductio: The amount of ticks reduced per Speed upgrade level (20 ticks = 1 second) [default = 20 ticks]
The interval in ticks between Loot Llamas spitting items out (20 ticks = 1 second) [default = 200 ticks])
llamapalooza.configuration.tables.toolti: The list of loot tables known to the mod (Syntax: namespace:loot_table_name, e.g. minecraft:chests/simple_dungeon)
